key_insight: The developed model effectively represents the interplay between gravity waves and wind farm wakes in boundary-layer dynamics.
engineering_relevance: This research aids in optimizing wind farm design by more accurately modeling environmental interactions.
method: Mixed spectral-finite-difference discretisation for computational efficiency.
Dynamic boundary conditions at the capping inversion for coupling effects.
evidence_signal: Model comparisons with large-eddy simulations demonstrate accurate reproduction of wind-farm dynamics and gravity-wave effects.
watch_item: The model's assumptions may limit its applicability in highly variable atmospheric conditions.
paper_title: Two-way coupling of gravity waves and wind farm wakes: a reduced-order boundary-layer model
